data.one_liner: A software analytics and static analysis tool for checking code metrics, lint rules, and unused code.
data.what_it_does: Dart Code Linter analyzes Dart and Flutter code against over 70 pre-built rules and metrics. It integrates into the analyzer via plugins and provides a CLI for running checks like unused files, localization, and dead code.
use_when: You want to enforce custom lint rules and architectural metrics in your Dart or Flutter project.
You need to detect unused code, files, or localizations in a repository.
avoid_when: Your Dart SDK version is unsupported by the current DCL release matrix.
You only require standard out-of-the-box Dart linter rules.
strengths: Comprehensive collection of custom rules and metrics with auto-fix support.
CLI commands for deep analysis including unused code and localization checks.
weaknesses: Requires careful compatibility management with specific Dart SDK and analyzer package versions.
Public members analysis for unused code can produce false positives.
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev dependency and configure in analysis_options.yaml.
